incidents.name: SafeMoon public burn() after upgrade
incidents.notes: An upgrade pushed hours before the incident made burn(address,uint256) callable by anyone, so the attacker burned nearly all SFM held by the SafeMoon/WBNB PancakeSwap pair, sync()'d the pool to the inflated SFM price and sold its own SFM back into the drained reserve.

sources.ref: src/test/2023-03/safeMoon_exp.sol (20230328 SafeMoon Hack - Access Control, lost $8.9M)

onchain review: SFM proxy 0x42981d0bfbaf196529376ee702f2a9eb9092fcb5 created 2021-12-03 by 0x678ee23173dce625a90ed651e91ca5138149f590 (SafeMoon deployer), unrelated to attack sender 0x286e09932b8d096cba3423d12965042736b8f850; 23 EIP-1967 Upgraded events, the last on 2023-03-28T13:10:56Z to implementation 0xeb11a0a0bef1ac028b8c2d4cd64138dd5938ca7a, i.e. 6h15m before the exploit - that upgrade introduced the public burn; ~80% of the funds were later returned
